newsitem.title: MEXICO: Tribasa's margins fall in Q1.
newsitem.headline: Tribasa's margins fall in Q1.

text.p: Gross profit margins at Mexican builder Grupo Tribasa SA fell during the first quarter to 24.9 percent from 30.6 percent during the year-ago quarter, the company said on Monday.

"Continous price increases in our inputs and weaker margins in our main international project, the Concepcion highway in Chile, ... affected our gross profit margins," the company said in a statement.
Earlier on Monday, the company reported first quarter net profits of 17.38 million pesos, versus 161.79 million during the same quarter of last year.
Operating margins also fell to 15.7 percent from 22.3 percent during the year-ago period, the company added.
Higher debt levels pushed up Tribasa's interest payments by 16.2 percent to 353.3 million pesos during the quarter compared to the same period of 1996.
